recommendations.title: Enable Embedding Cache Pre-Warm for Standard Invoice Layouts
recommendations.reasoning: Telemetry reveals 42% of documents share one of 5 standard vendor invoice templates.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Reduce average extraction latency by 450ms and token costs by 22%.
recommendations.estimated_impact: P95 AI Extraction Latency decreases from 3100ms to 2650ms.

recommendations.title: Implement Adaptive Dynamic Worker Autoscaling on Queue Backlog Derivative
recommendations.reasoning: Periodic batch uploads cause short-lived 3-minute queue spikes before manual/HPA scaling triggers.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Eliminate queue backlog spikes under bursty traffic without over-provisioning idle workers.
recommendations.estimated_impact: Zero queue dwell time spikes above 100ms during peak bursts.

recommendations.title: Automate Partition Pruning for Operational Audit Logs Older than 90 Days
recommendations.reasoning: Historical audit tables are growing at 8.5% MoM; cold partition tiering will conserve high-IOPS NVMe storage.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Preserve high database IOPS for real-time document CRUD operations.
recommendations.estimated_impact: Reclaim ~35% primary SSD storage space and maintain sub-10ms query times.
